title: Action de Galois sur Teichmüller : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting, continued from the previous page: K is a subfield of C, X is a K-variety, and X = X(C). Π_1(X) is the topological fundamental groupoid with objects the points of X(C). \hat Π_1(X) is its profinite completion, identified with the étale (schematic) fundamental groupoid of X_C. Π = Aut_{K-cat}(C) = Aut(C/K) is the huge, non-topologized group of field automorphisms of C over K.

This page makes four points.

(i) Π acts on the set X(C). Because the étale groupoid has a purely algebraic definition, Π also acts on the groupoid \hat Π_1(X). An automorphism u of C gives a semilinear automorphism of the scheme X_C over X, which transports finite étale covers and fibre functors.

(ii) If λ: x→y is a topological path, ^uλ is in general not a topological path from ^ux to ^uy, only a profinite one. Π does not act on Π_1 itself, only on its completion.

(iii) In the notation ^ux and ^uλ, the action is by functors (formula (6)): ^u(id_x) = id_{^ux} and ^u(μλ) = ^uμ ^uλ.

(iv) One restricts to the full subgroupoids on the set X(K̄), where K̄ is the algebraic closure of K in C. Call these Π_1(X_{K̄}) and \hat Π_1(X_{K̄}). The second is Π-stable. Put Γ = Aut_{K-cat}(K̄) = Gal(K̄/K) (formula (7)). Then Γ is a quotient of Π, and the action of Π on \hat Π_1(X_{K̄}) factors through Γ. The page's last line says 'Π_1(X_{K̄})' without the hat; read it as the hatted groupoid.

The purpose is to set up the outer, and in fact groupoid-level, Galois action on profinite fundamental groupoids with K̄-rational base points. The next page turns this into the cocycles f_l(u) = l^{-1}·^ul and g_l(u) = ^ul·l^{-1}, computed on generators coming from topological paths. This is the standard framework later used for the Galois action on Teichmüller groupoids and on P^1 minus {0,1,∞}.
errors:
No real error. Points the text leaves implicit:
- That the action factors through Γ uses the invariance of the étale fundamental groupoid under extension of algebraically closed fields of characteristic 0 (X_{K̄} versus X_C). In particular, Aut(C/K̄) acts trivially on \hat Π_1(X_{K̄}).
- That Π → Γ is surjective uses the extension of automorphisms of K̄ to C (transcendence basis plus Zorn).
- Conventions for a left action, and the semilinearity of u on X_C, are not spelled out.

ideas.what: Aut(C/K) acts on the profinite (étale) fundamental groupoid of X_C, but not on the topological groupoid; topological paths are moved to profinite paths only.
ideas.modern_name: Galois action on the étale fundamental groupoid; comparison with the profinite completion of the topological groupoid (Riemann existence)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (SGA1); widely used by Ihara, Deligne, Nakamura and others
ideas.where_published: SGA1 (étale fundamental group and groupoid, Riemann existence); Esquisse d'un programme (Galois action on Teichmüller groupoids)

ideas.what: Functoriality of the action: u(id_x) = id_{^ux} and u(μλ) = ^uμ ^uλ.
ideas.modern_name: Group action on a groupoid by functors

ideas.what: Restriction to the full subgroupoid on K̄-points, on which the action of Aut(C/K) factors through Gal(K̄/K).
ideas.modern_name: Galois action on the fundamental groupoid with multiple rational base points (precursor of tangential base-point groupoids)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (fundamental groupoids with several base points)

deep.surprise_reason: A careful but standard setup of the Galois action on profinite fundamental groupoids with algebraic base points. Its only slight particularity is that it starts from the big group Aut(C/K) acting on all of X(C) and then descends to Gal(K̄/K). This is well known and appears in substance in SGA1 and the Esquisse.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: the acting group is Π (= Aut_{K-cat}(C)), not Γ. Read 'donc Π opère non seulement sur l'ens. X'.
Line 8: the notation line reads 'Notations ^ux (x∈X, u∈Π) et ^uλ : ^ux → ^uy si λ: x→y (dans \hat Π_1(X))'; the group is Π, not Γ.
Line 4: 'faisant pas intervenir la topologie de C' is correct.

After (6): the illegible passage is roughly 'Notons d'ailleurs qu'on n'a pas besoin de déterminer entièrement l'action de Π. À vrai dire, si K̄ est la clôture algébrique de K dans C, ...'. The duplicated 'dire' in the machine transcription is spurious.
End of page: 'on sait que Γ est un quotient de Π, l'action de Π sur \hat Π_1(X_{K̄}) se fait à travers Γ'. The transcription confuses Π and Γ here.
